dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D narrowing observed from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle, appearing smooth and continuous.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None; lateral margins where skin meets water exhibit smooth, uninterrupted geometric lines without visible bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse light-grey clusters are visible, primarily concentrated toward the posterior half of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradient between residual pigmented patches and the depigmented white baseline is gradual rather than sharp.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct dark-pixel linear disruption consisting of two roughly parallel marks located on the mid-left dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Paired linear dark marks on the mid-left dorsal surface consistent with healed or recent epidermal abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible, high-contrast circular blowhole aperture located at the anterior apex of the visible dorsal plane.
